problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: size 39 cubic feet
* Package Beta: size 63 cubic feet
* Package Gamma: size 50 cubic feet
* Package Delta: size 38 cubic feet
* Package Epsilon: size 43 cubic feet
* Package Zeta: size 41 cubic feet
* Package Eta: size 58 cubic feet
* Package Theta: size 52 cubic feet
* Package Iota: size 54 cubic feet
* Package Kappa: size 57 cubic feet
* Package Lambda: size 61 cubic feet
* Package Mu: size 54 cubic feet
* Package Nu: size 44 cubic feet
* Package Xi: size 42 cubic feet
* Package Omicron: size 58 cubic feet
* Package Pi: size 43 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
